requirements.title: Human-Editable Scenario File Format
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall be defined in a human-editable text file format.
requirements.rationale: PM-required scenario authoring without recompilation; supports reviewable, diffable scenario configuration.

requirements.title: Launch Site Configuration
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall specify launch site geodetic latitude, longitude, and elevation.
requirements.rationale: PM-required launch site parameterization so simulated GPS and nav anchor to a configurable location.

requirements.title: Motor Thrust Curve Configuration
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall specify a time-indexed motor thrust curve for the simulated vehicle.
requirements.rationale: PM-required motor parameterization so different motors can be simulated for FT1 baseline and variants.

requirements.title: Vehicle Mass and Drag Configuration
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall specify simulated vehicle mass and aerodynamic drag parameters.
requirements.rationale: PM-required vehicle dynamics parameterization to match FT1 airframe properties for realistic trajectories.

requirements.title: Atmospheric Conditions Configuration
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall specify atmospheric pressure, temperature, and wind parameters.
requirements.rationale: PM-required atmospheric parameterization so baro and aero models reflect day-of-flight conditions.

requirements.title: Sensor Noise Parameter Configuration
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall specify per-sensor noise and bias parameters for IMU, baro, and GPS.
requirements.rationale: PM-required sensor noise parameterization so simulated sensor outputs match realistic FT1 hardware behavior.

requirements.title: Truth State Output File
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall write truth vehicle state to a sidecar output file during each simulation run.
requirements.rationale: PM-required truth-state recording enables post-run comparison of FSW nav output to ground truth.

requirements.title: Truth State Recording Rate
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall record truth state at the simulation integration rate.
requirements.rationale: PM-required full-rate truth recording so post-run analysis is not aliased by truth subsampling.

requirements.title: Monotonic Simulation Time Stamping
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall stamp every truth state record with monotonic simulation time.
requirements.rationale: PM-required monotonic sim time stamping enables alignment of truth records with FSW log records.

requirements.title: True Phase Transition Timestamps
requirements.description: The sim scenario shall record the true simulation time of each flight phase transition.
requirements.rationale: PM-required true phase transition record supports SW-REQ-SYS-018 AFM ±1 s tolerance comparison.

requirements.title: FT1 Default Baseline Scenario
requirements.description: The sim scenario set shall include a default FT1 baseline scenario with G-class motor and nominal noise.
requirements.rationale: PM-required canonical FT1 scenario (~600 m apogee, nominal noise) for repeatable regression simulation runs.

requirements.title: Scenario Selection via Command Line
requirements.description: The sim scenario loader shall select among multiple scenarios via Trick command line argument.
requirements.rationale: PM-required ability to switch scenarios without rebuilding supports nominal and off-nominal regression runs.
